Built from a love for one dog, dedicated to caring for yours.

Elevated Pet Services was inspired by my own dog, Snoop, who showed me just how important trust, routine, and genuine care are in a pet's life.

Today, I bring that same level of dedication to every pet I care for, offering personalized in-home services that help pets stay happy, comfortable, and stress-free in their familiar environment.

What We Offer

Four ways to care for your pet

Every visit is one-on-one — no pack walks, no shared attention. Just your pet, and someone they already trust.

Dog Walking

Personalized walks tailored to your dog's pace and energy, right in your neighborhood. Plenty of exercise, potty breaks, fresh air, and love.

  • Reliable & on-time
  • Building trust one walk at a time
  • Photo update after every walk

Drop-In Visits

Grooming Services

Clean pets, happy hearts. Pricing is based on your dog's size and coat length — final pricing may vary by coat condition and temperament.

  • Basic & deluxe bath packages
  • Nail trim & teeth brushing add-ons
  • Complimentary bandana with deluxe
Please note: dogs must have previously been to a groomer or been bathed before — we're unable to groom dogs that have never been bathed.
